verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim's first-party docs show the full story. Robots and scenes can be imported from URDF, MJCF, CAD or USD, simulated with the PhysX or Newton physics engines, and fitted with RTX and physics-based sensors. Pre-hardware validation is supported through ROS 2, software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, and the GitHub repo adds robot tuning for physics accuracy. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of physics and sensor realism (the community items are about GR00T, not simulation fidelity).
